description: Rank-qualified weighted wave pools for a PvE mission, including evaluation bounds and boss-wave flags.

Id.technical: FName import key/row name for FGameDataTableRow_PvEMissionWaveLottery. PvEMission rows supply Id_PvEMissionWaveLottery ids, which are resolved over PvEMissionWaveLotteryDataTables (DTM+0x920); the member is not otherwise read by the picker.

Id_MissionWave.technical: TArray<FName>, default empty. Each non-None entry is paired with the same-index Weights, EvaluationMin, EvaluationMax and bBoss into a wave candidate. Picked ids are written into the PvE wave list; exported rows pad unused slots with None, which are skipped.

Weights.simple: Relative chance of selecting each candidate wave.
Weights.technical: TArray<float>, default empty. Candidates with Weight <= 0 are dropped; a wave id already present in PreviousWaves has its weight multiplied by 0.5. Each pick calls GamePvE_PickWeightedIndex over the remaining candidate weights, then removes the chosen candidate. The output list is initially three PVE_X_WAVE_0000 placeholders and is sized to min(candidate count, 3).

EvaluationMin.simple: Lower bound on player evaluation for this wave candidate.
EvaluationMin.technical: TArray<EGameBattleResultEvaluation>, default empty. Cast to uint8 and used with the same-index EvaluationMax: when both are non-zero and Rank is not 255, the candidate is skipped unless Rank lies within the inclusive [Min, Max] range. A zero (None) bound means that side imposes no restriction; rank 255 bypasses the filter entirely.

EvaluationMax.simple: Upper bound on player evaluation for this wave candidate.
EvaluationMax.technical: TArray<EGameBattleResultEvaluation>, default empty. Paired with EvaluationMin for the inclusive rank test described above; exported rows use None, C and S values to create rank bands.

bBoss.simple: Marks a candidate wave as the boss wave.
bBoss.technical: TArray<bool>, default empty. When a boss candidate is picked it is written to Out.Last() and all boss candidates are removed from the remaining pool; non-boss picks fill earlier indices. This forces at most one boss wave at the end of the selected list.

notes: The exported asset has 614 rows with FGameDataTableRow_PvEMissionWaveLottery; the manager loads PvEMissionWaveLotteryDataTable into PvEMissionWaveLotteryDataTables (DTM+0x920).
All candidate arrays are parallel and indexed directly by the same loop index; exported rows pad unused slots with None/zero/false.
Survival mode (GameMode == 2) does not use this table; it selects sequential PVE_SURVIVAL_WAVE_LOTTERY ids from the mission instead.
Picker 0x1306fe0 is reconstructed; status/functions.json should be consulted for byte status. Content is partial and Blueprint uses were not exhaustively inspected.

usages.detail: GamePvE_PickMissionWaves resolves PvEMission's wave-lottery ids into rows.
Builds rank-qualified wave candidates from the parallel arrays.
Performs weighted picks with previous-wave penalties and boss-last placement.
